name: Potiphar
description: Egyptian living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: The Midianites sold him in Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh and captain of the guard.

Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hands of the Ishmaelites. And the Lord was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; his master saw that the Lord was with him, and made him overseer over his house.

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org

cases.name: Potiphar’s wife
cases.charge: Soliciting her husband’s servant day by day, and bearing false witness against him when he fled
cases.preview: She set her eyes on Joseph and asked him day by day to lie with her, and he refused, naming it a great wickedness and a sin against God.
